title: Resolution on the deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the “Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice”
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘humanitarian visas and’
part_context: Urges the EU, the Member States and other donor states to increase humanitarian aid and funding to support basic needs and livelihoods and Afghan civil society, ensure flexible funding for NGOs and their female aid workers and grant <del>humanitarian visas and</del> promised visas for the international coalition’s Afghan former employees; stresses the need for the international community to assess the recent decree’s impact on humanitarian operations;
